candidate.user_submission: Pikin dey 18 months old. Im get fever, and e don dey for 2 days. Im body temperature na 38.0°C. E no dey convulse now and dem never see am get convulsion before. Di pikin no dey lethargic and e dey conscious. E fit drink or breastfeed. E no dey vomit everything. Fever dey, but malaria test wey dem do show NEGATIVE and malaria risk still high. No sign say e get generalized rash. Im eye no red. E no get runny nose. E never get measles for di last 3 months. E no dey cough or get difficult to breathe. Dem no see obvious cause for di fever, and dem never identify any bacterial cause. Dem no see pus for im eye, and im neck no stiff. Im no get ear problem, and im no get diarrhoea. Dem fit do malaria test.
